definitions.explanation: Thread or yarn spun from cotton fibers. Used in textile manufacturing, sewing, and crafts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{綿糸|めんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{織|お}られている→織る：04373_oru⟧。
examples.english: This cloth is woven with cotton yarn.

examples.japanese: {綿糸|めんし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Cotton yarn is gentle on the skin, so it is often used for baby clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿糸|めんし}⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧し、⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧な{輸出品|ゆしゅつひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During the Meiji era, Japan's cotton yarn production developed rapidly and became one of the major exports.

notes:
Combines ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧ (cotton) and {糸|し} (thread, yarn). An important term in Japanese economic history, as cotton spinning was one of the first modern industries in Meiji-era Japan. Today used in textile and craft contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿糸|めんし}{紡績|ぼうせき}: cotton spinning
- {綿糸|めんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to knit with cotton yarn
- {綿糸|めんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: cotton yarn production
- {太|ふと}{番手|ばんて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿糸|めんし}: thick-count cotton yarn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絹糸|けんし}: silk thread — a more luxurious fiber
- ⟦{毛糸|けいと}→毛糸：00212_keito⟧: wool yarn — used for knitting, read with kun'yomi
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧: cotton (fabric) — the finished textile rather than the yarn
